PointerEvent : MouseEvent; target.dispatchEvent(new Ctor(t, opts)); } target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', opts)); ``` This opens the real "EDIT IMAGE" dialog (Title / Body / Clickthrough URL), which IS a normal ``/`

cannot see this class of defect. If a long heading is genuinely wanted on such a page, it
belongs in an H2 below the scaled H1, not in the H1 itself.

## `.sqs-block-code` `.last()` is a booby trap once a page has a footer Code Block (29 Aug)

`build4.mjs` (the ERF `/our-classes` payload pusher) opens the editor via
`F().locator(".sqs-block-code").last()`. That was correct when written. It is now **wrong and
destructive**: `/our-classes` has two code blocks, and the last one is the **footer**.

| index | block id | contents |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `block-yui_3_17_2_1_1787741602756_4836` | the `.erf-oc` page payload (~13,200 chars) |
| 1 | `block-yui_3_17_2_1_1787757922537_1762` | the site **footer** (~8,800 chars) |

Running `build4.mjs` unmodified would `Ctrl+A` `Ctrl+V` the page payload over the footer, and
its byte-exact readback would have reported **BYTE-EXACT** while doing so - the readback
compares the editor against the payload, so it confirms a successful paste into the *wrong*
block just as happily as into the right one.

**Always address a Code Block by its `id`, never by position**, and assert the open editor's
identity before pasting:

```js
const peek = await cm.locator(".cm-content").first().innerText();
if (!/erf-oc/.test(peek)) throw new Error("wrong block - nothing pasted");
```

`build5.mjs` in `docs/clients/engineroomfitness/our-classes-rebuild/` is `build4.mjs` with
both fixes. Prefer it. General form: **an ordinal selector encodes an assumption about page
structure that later edits silently invalidate, and a self-consistent verifier will not catch
it.**
